links.comparator_used: Human expert panel review (3 human experts), assessed via inter-human agreement
links.outcome: Agreement on faithfulness verification of summaries
links.effect: LLM panel vs human panel kappa 0.67, versus inter-human 0.43 (95% CI 0.34-0.52) and inter-LLM 0.40 (0.38-0.42)
links.quote: LLM panel vs human panel agreement was substantial (kappa 0.67), outperforming agreement among the interhuman (0.43 [95% CI, 0.34-0.52]) and inter-LLM (0.40 [0.38-0.42]) panels.

links.comparator_used: Human-written/expert-written plain language summaries from BioLaySumm
links.quote: Finally, LLM-generated PLS were more readable than human-written versions (FRE 42.3 [interquartile range, IQR 35.27-49.41] vs 28.8 [IQR 21.02-36.18]).

design_hint: LLM panel faithfulness verification of generated summaries
